items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Ruby Braff, you know who Ruby Braff, the cornet? And Sonny Greer was the drummer.

ctx.x: When you got out of Hamilton do you think, did you feel like you had had a bargain at this college? And I’m sort of asking that in the relationship of what it cost back then?

I can’t remember what my dad, who was a dentist, and what he paid. It was a few thousand I guess. A bargain. Yeah I think I thought I’ve gotten an awful lot. I was impressed, the college was small, three or four hundred people when I came up here. And the ratio of faculty to students was terrific. We had some classes with four and five people in it. And loved those teachers, those professors. Paul Parker, who became the pianist in the Alumni All-Stars, was a dear man who became very friendly and he would come…
And were you in a fraternity?
